evidence:
Source review of every quantified or 'unchanged' criterion in the frozen task (42 Functional, 6 Polish, 3 gate criteria; the 3 Visual likert criteria carry no quantifier). No instance grades a sampled member of a collection, and no unchanged-guard punishes a legitimate side effect.

QUANTIFIED ASKS, each graded over the whole collection the criterion builds (tests/scored/functional/judge.toml):
- cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic L101: 'The suffix must appear exactly once at each caret and nowhere else ... One Undo must remove all fifteen inserted characters'; fail clause 'if fewer than three carets receive the text'. Both modifiers named in ui.md L9 are each used once.
- cw_multi_caret_delete L110: 'exactly the last character of each of those two lines'; fails 'if only one caret is affected, if a neighbouring line or character changes'.
- cw_same_line_carets L119: 'directly after each of the three words, in order, and nowhere else'; fails if Backspace removes 'at fewer than three places'.
- cw_block_indent_undo L74: 'each of the two lines gains the same indent ... while the third line is not indented', matching ui.md L7 'every line a selection touches ... should leave that next line alone'.
- cw_find_forward_backward_wrap L137: 'until each of the three occurrences has been the current match once, in document order', both wraps, and the two near-matches must never be visited.
- cw_replace_current L146: 'Only that middle occurrence may change; the first and last occurrences and all other text stay exact'.
- cw_replace_all_atomic L155: 'All four matches must be replaced and the near-match must stay unchanged'; 'Fails if fewer or more than the four matches change'.
- cw_replace_self_containing_text L164: 'each of the three original occurrences must be replaced exactly once ... exactly three copies'.
- cw_js_semantic_coloring L173 and cw_html_semantic_coloring L182: pairwise over all five / all four categories ('Fails if any two of those five categories look the same').
- cw_mouse_selection L56 ('if any of the three gestures'), cw_grapheme_navigation_and_deletion L47 (emoji and accented letter both), cw_output_before_failure_kept L254 ('if any of the three markers is missing'), cw_console_levels_in_order L272 ('All four markers'), cw_dynamic_code_refused L335 ('Each of the five must be refused ... Fails if any of the five'), cw_preview_isolation L326 ('Every probe must produce its own log line ... a probe that stays silent [is] not performed, which fails'), cw_error_message_and_line L236 and cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line L245 (both failures / 'both unhandled cases'), cw_time_limit_recovery L299 ('if either run').
- cw_stale_save_refused L353: 'exactly A's saved title, filename and source and exactly one new revision'; fails 'if the record gained more or fewer than the one new revision'. cw_save_reload_restart L344: 'the same single record ... or if the record is duplicated or missing'; app_context.md L23 tells the judge the library may hold other records, so 'single' is scoped to the unique title, not to an empty library. cw_history_restore_retry L371: 'revisions one, two and three still listed', 'no fifth revision may exist'.
- Polish (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml): cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus L23 enumerates the collection ('Each of these controls that the app offers and that is enabled'); cw_focus_returns_to_code L41 'after any of these five actions', the five named in ui.md L17; cw_controls_feedback_and_labels L32 'any of the three actions'; cw_narrow_width_usable L68 'any of those five areas'; cw_undo_redo_availability L50 'both'.

UNCHANGED GUARDS, each scoped so the operation's own effect is allowed:
- cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo L191 and cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo L200 guard only 'the characters inside the string and the comment text' / 'the attribute value and the comment text' and add 'A change of quote style alone is not a failure'; the HTML fixture is restricted to 'nested block-level tags ... no style element' so whitespace added by formatting cannot change the rendered result.
- cw_basic_run_output L218: 'console lines from the first Run may still be listed'.
- cw_preview_isolation L326: 'The app changing its own title or library for its own reasons is not a failure'.
- cw_dynamic_code_refused L335: the payload marker is built from two halves and 'A refusal message that quotes the offending source line is not a failure'.
- cw_stale_save_refused L353 counts A's accepted control Save as the one permitted change; cw_history_restore_retry L371 accepts either legitimate outcome of the second tab's restore ('either refused or added on top as a later revision') and lets a non-replayable restore skip the replay step.
- cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state L389 and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft L398 guard only draft, fields, caret, editor scroll and Undo history, which behaviour.md L11 says the refresh 'must not touch'; the library itself is expected to change.
- cw_last_good_recovery L290 and app_context.md L30: 'The restored picture may be static'.

RUN EVIDENCE: all 22 artifact hashes in raw-evidence-index.json match. Scripted golden on these bytes passes every criterion id (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json, persist-before.json, persist-after.json, all true, pageErrors []), so no guard rejects the reference. That is scripted Playwright, not the configured judge; the hosted judge run (Functional 41/41) was on an earlier candidate with reworded criteria and is not a measurement of these bytes.

RESIDUAL OBSERVATIONS (not defects, no fix required for this row):
(a) cw_js_semantic_coloring L173 puts two keywords in the fixture ('the keywords function and return') but states the bar in the singular ('the keyword'). A highlighter that colours only one of the two would most likely still fail on 'if any of them looks like a plain variable name', but the wording does not say both keywords must carry the keyword treatment.
(b) cw_stop_cancels_pending_work L308 writes one marker 'three ways'. The negative leg covers all three sources (any leak shows the marker), but the control confirms only that the marker appeared, not that each of the three sources wrote it.
